message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: The defendant is legal representative of a company, evaded paying wages of 51 employees amounting to 378,912 RMB, using escape, phone off, etc. He was ordered to pay but didn't. After, the court auctioned equipment and paid 115,206 RMB to employees. He confessed.

What crimes? Under Chinese criminal law, refusing to pay wages can be "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (refusal to pay labor remuneration). Also "逃避支付劳动报酬罪". The law: Article 277 of Criminal Law: "用人单位克扣或者不支付劳动者的劳动报酬，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also "逃避支付劳动报酬罪" is similar. So the crime is "拒不支付劳动报酬罪". Also possibly "非法占有" but not here. The fact includes escape to avoid payment, but the core is refusal to pay wages. So single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬罪<eoa>
